findings.detail: Pass needs at least 0.39 of authored main-path wild sites engaged once (primary assumes 0.5); at 0.25 the first failing checkpoint is cloudreach_entry. Implied fight time at 1.5 min/fight: meadows 6.68 h of 5–7 h, tidewake 4.1 h of 3.5–6 h, cloudreach 1.3 h of 3.5–6 h, stormwood 5.9 h of 3.5–6 h. An agent-piloted normal route (F47#0) must confirm the engagement rate.
cloudreach has no alpha_respawns.json site, so the alpha loop pays nothing there.

The ordinary path reaches the L60 pass ceiling by stormwood_finale_ready (Stormwood exit target 55): hybrid auto XP at auto_xp_scale 0.35 plus essence overshoots late; F47 owns tuning. Grind cannot add levels at the ceiling.
tidewake_entry 24 vs 20; cloudreach_entry 34 vs 31; stormwood_finale_ready 60 vs 54; stormwood_exit 60 vs 55. Not a deficit; F47 measures and tunes the curve (PROGRESSION §8).
TRAINING §1/PROGRESSION §5 name bosses as a Tether Candy source; no boss reward row authors tether_candy (only masters.json candy:2 and bounty templates). Counted as 0.
All 32 essence_nodes.json nodes are placement.off_route:true with terrain_and_player_path_proven:false; none counted on the ordinary path.
Every water_pickups creature_candy row is off_main_route:true; Tidewake ordinary path credits no found candy.
